notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.notes:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

You will discover the creative process behind the creation of the procedural music of Winds & Leaves, composed by Vibe Avenue! Join us on our melodic journey!

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509895/aefb839e06560bf2c2d8de01c270230f14745c47.png[/img]

notes.title: Winds & Leaves' soundtrack is now available
notes.notes:
Hey gardeners! 🌳 

We're releasing the Winds & Leaves' soundtrack, created by award-winning composers Vibe Avenue! This downloadable playlist is a capture of the original musical immersion, where each of the 22 tracks is designed to procedurally react to the player's environment. We recommend listening to it to get your work done… or just relax! 🧘‍♀️Hope you'll love it as much as we do! 

 Find it now on Steam: bit.ly/3gXnGTr 

To fully live the experience, equip your VR headset to embark on an adventure in the world of Winds & Leaves!

notes.title: Winds & Leaves - Minor update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are happy to launch a minor Winds & Leaves update today! We are mainly addressing some issues that were reported. See the changelog below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509895/c88ac4a39377cf0d43fbb0e8c45e54312200166a.gif[/img]

•	Fixed some missing texts in the traditional and simplified Chinese versions.
•	Fixed a bug where the looming cataclysm was not appearing accordingly with the player’s progression.
•	We now display the build number in the main menu to be able to provide better support.
•	We changed the support of Oculus headsets in the backend directly through SteamVR. (It should fix the fact that managing the audio output on some headsets (notably Quest via Air Link) was a bit cumbersome for the players)
•	You can now interact with the in-game menus with either the Grip or the Trigger.
•	Fixed an issue where some trees in the landmarks were misplaced and clipped.
•	Other minor fixes.

We’re hoping you will enjoy your journey in the Steppe in the upcoming Holidays!

Vincent from TREBUCHET

notes.title: Winds & Leaves is out today!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to have Winds & Leaves finally arrive to Steam today. We have put a lot of work in making the PC version take advantage of the added power and be compatible with all the major headsets.

If you’re new to the game, jump on your stilts and become the Gardener to discover a barren world and use your ancient powers to bring it back to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509895/64ebf8ebeed2fb168a2c6c6deb38c10d96bd903a.gif[/img]

For those who tried it on PS4, enjoy the enhanced graphics and the all new room-scale mode, letting you immerse yourself even more in the forests you’re growing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509895/24b0fbbf449a10e8c38e22ce25400db5252107c7.gif[/img]

Stay tuned with Winds & Leaves and what we’re up to at TREBUCHET by following our twitter account [url=https://twitter.com/trebuchetvr]@trebuchetvr[/url] !

Happy tree planting!

Alexandre from TREBUCHET
